remarks: Spacious & bright 1 bed 1 bath condo unit at the Crosswinds Condominium has so much to offer! Open floor plan flowing from living room to dining area & kitchen with southern exposure, inviting lots of natural light into the unit. Fully remodeled kitchen with brand new stainless steel appliances, contemporary cabinetry & tiled backsplash. Brand new hardwood floors, fresh paint throughout the unit, ample closet storage, remodeled bathroom and energy efficient windows. It comes with a reserved parking. Laundry located on the same floor. Close to downtown Stamford, this condo is centrally located and nearby restaurants, shopping, businesses, UConn (Stamford Campus) and access to I-95. Heat and hot water included.
